entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. This is unbelievable. I want my money back, now.
I can certainly look into that for you. Just to make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's not a fault, it's the fact that I haven't even had a chance to open the box! I had a major medical emergency right after it was delivered. I was stuck in the hospital, nearly needed surgery, and on top of that, I had to deal with my son's deployment getting moved up. It's been a complete nightmare. This is the first moment I've had.

I am so sorry to hear you went through all of that. That sounds incredibly difficult, and I hope you're on the road to recovery. Let me just pull up your order information and check the return eligibility for you.
You do that. And it had better be eligible. I'm not playing games. If you tell me no, I want your manager and I'll make sure everyone online knows how VeloFit treats its customers.

I understand your frustration. Let me see... Okay, I've got your order. I'm checking our official knowledge base now... and yes, here it is. Our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
I see you received the band 24 days ago, so you are well within that 90-day window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh. Well... okay then. That's what I expected. So you're sending me a shipping label?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating that for you right now. You should receive an email with the prepaid return label and instructions within the next 5 minutes. Just package the item back up, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
